findings.summary: Focusable table-scroll wrappers use aria-label on generic divs without a region role, so assistive technology may not expose their scroll purpose when focused.
findings.fix: Add role="region" to each named, keyboard-focusable table-scroll wrapper so its existing aria-label identifies the scrollable area.
findings.evidence: <div class="admin-table-scroll" tabindex="0" aria-label="Admin accounts table; scroll horizontally to view all columns">

passed: Skip link targets the focusable main content area.
Mobile menu uses a button with aria-expanded; opening moves focus into the menu and Escape returns focus to the button.
Menu links, form controls, and buttons have visible focus styles; form fields have associated labels.
Long sidebar and responsive table containers are keyboard-focusable for scrolling.
notes: Runtime keyboard and viewport scans could not run because Playwright is not installed.
